purpose: A panel anchored to the control that opened it, in the top layer, with light dismiss, Escape, and flipping when there is no room.

supplied: the trigger carries aria-expanded and aria-controls
Escape closes and focus returns to the trigger
a click outside dismisses without trapping focus, which is what makes it a popover and not a modal
the panel renders in the top layer, so no ancestor's overflow clips it
required: an accessible name on the trigger when it is an icon
do not put a form that must be completed in here — focus is not trapped, so a user can wander out of it. That is a Modal.

composition.notes: A popover does not trap focus. Anything that must be finished before the user moves on belongs in a Modal instead.

safeMutations.rationale: Placement is presentation and the component re-flips it anyway when space runs out. `open` is the application's state.

propNotes.side: A preference, not a guarantee: it flips when there is no room, which is the behaviour you want.
